info.name: Observe per-sector progress and return sectors to celebrate

items.docs:
Single endpoint driving the brain unlock celebration lifecycle.

The FE POSTs the current per-sector "above threshold?" map on
every progress change. The BE compares each sector against the
stored row in ``BrainSectorUnlockSeen`` and returns the list of
sectors whose modal should now fire:
